card.name: Word starts Hol- and Hom-
card.fires_on: The word-start pieces "Hol" and "Hom" (also "Aut") at the start of a capitalized name or a technical term, where more letters must follow.

modes.label: Hol- in names
modes.description: "Hol" begins a surname or place name that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: Danny Merritt, Stephani<< Hol>>zwarth, and team leader Kyle

modes.label: Hom- in terms
modes.description: "Hom" begins a longer term such as homonym, homozygous or homatropine.
modes.example: Spell Checker<< Hom>>onym/homophone checker Word Prediction Out

modes.label: Aut- in terms
modes.description: "Aut" begins the word autologous at the start of a repeated title.
modes.example: ologous Peripheral Blood Progenitor Cell and Bone Marrow Transplantation<< Aut>>ologous Peripheral Blood Progenitor Cell

card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a word that starts with Hol or Hom, when the rest of the word has not yet appeared.
